(I)--born of anger of ब्रह्मा; name explained; ‘the weapon’: places assigned to him; his women; asked to procreate and be a प्रजापति; created beings which would burn the universe; persuaded by ब्रह्मा to stop this, and proceed to तपस्; expression of the तमस्।
1: भा. III. १२, 7-२०;

, ३०. ३८.
Claimed the remaining wealth of the Angirasa sacrificers as his own, which नाभाग thought was his. When नाभाग gave it to Rudra, the worshipful god presented him that wealth and disappeared; presented पृथु with a sword दशचन्द्र।
2: Ib.

No offerings by दक्ष in his sacrifice, and सती's voluntary death. Rudra created वीरभद्र to cause दक्ष's death. ब्रह्मा pacified Rudra and revived दक्ष and others.

8: Ib. X. ch. ८८ (whole).
[page३-089+ ४५] The presiding deity of the planet शनैश्चर. कालो- Rudra is शिव; at the end of a Kalpa he assumes the form of a Samvarttaka sun and burns down all the worlds. His own messengers of death; worshipped by काम with शत- रुद्रीय.
9: Br. II. २४. ४९;

. ७०; 7. ३८; १०. ८७; ११. ३३; १५. २४; ३०. 8; ३६. १६; ४०. १३ and २७.
Enshrined in गोकर्ण.
१०: Ib. III. १३. २०.
Destroyed the god of Love and married उमा on the advice of the seven sages; marriage rites described.
११:

१२: Ib. ch. १५५.
आडि, son of Andhaka, who attacked him was killed.
१३: Ib. ch. १५६.
Agni's entrance into the harem when शिव made him drink his वीर। This was God सुब्रह्मण्य nursed by कृत्तिकस्;
१४: Ib. ch. १५८.

१५: Ib. ch. १८८; २२५. १३; २५३. ४२.
Icon of; in the form of a १६ year old boy; worshipped before buildings; different postures detailed.

(II)--born of Ananta from between the agitat- ed brows: Exhibited in eleven forms with शूल and three eyes. His name is सन्कर्षण. भा. V. २५. 3;
(III)--a Mt. west of the शितोद. वा. ३६. २७.

According to the ब्र्। प्। sons of सुरभी and कश्यप. These are अन्गारक, Sarpa, निऋऋति, Sadasaspati, अजैकपात्, Ahirbudhnya, ऊर्ध्वकेतु, Jvara, [page३-090+ ३२] Bhuvana, ईश्वर, मृत्यु, and कपालि. Their sisters were रोहिणी and गान्धर्वी: Their overlord was वृषध्वज. Live in शिवपुरम्:
